physics-killer-04.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
physics-killer-04.topic: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
physics-killer-04.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-04.material: A gbapụrụ bọọlụ n'akụkụ larịị site n'ọnụ ugwu dị elu $20\,\mathrm{m}$, ọ daakwa n'ala n'ebe larịị $30\,\mathrm{m}$ site n'ugwu. Ọ bụrụ na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ ma e leghaara ọgbụgba ikuku anya, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ọsọ bọọlụ n'oge ọ metụrụ ala, na $\tan\theta$ nke akụkụ $\theta$ ntụziaka ọsọ na-eme na larịị n'oge ahụ?
physics-killer-04.thinking.0: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: A gbapụrụ bọọlụ n'akụkụ larịị site n'ọnụ ugwu dị elu $20\,\mathrm{m}$, ọ daakwa n'ala n'ebe larịị $30\,\mathrm{m}$ site n'ugwu. Ọ bụrụ na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ ma e leghaara ọgbụgba ikuku anya, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ọsọ bọọlụ n'oge ọ metụrụ ala, na $\tan\theta$ nke akụkụ $\theta$ ntụziaka ọsọ na-eme na larịị n'oge ahụ?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Kwụ ọtọ $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Larịị $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Tupu ọdịda $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Ọ bụrụ na e gbakwunyere ọsọ dị ka $v_0+gt=35$, azịza na-ezighị ezi ①; ọ bụrụ na e tụgharịa $\tan\theta$, $\frac34$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ②); ọ bụrụ na e were akụkụ kwụ ọtọ $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ naanị dị ka ọsọ, azịza na-ezighị ezi ④.
